paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in the Tosefta, Ma'aser Sheni, beginning of chapter 4 (Zuckermandel edition), but says that in ‘our version’ it reads Abba Chilkiah of Karuya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Zuckermandel reading has Chilfa ben Keruya; Hyman’s current version has Chilkiah of Karuya.

The whole Mechon Mamre digital Tosefta Maaser Sheni chapter 4 was read; its third paragraph names Abba Chilkiah of Keruya (אבא חלקיה מן קרויה). This supports that side of Hyman’s comparison. The Chilfa ben Keruya heading and the Zuckermandel reading remain Hyman’s report; Zuckermandel’s printed edition was not freshly collated. The existing note is retained with that limitation, without an alias or parentage binding.
